messages:
anya: dropping a new variant for the first-run empty state we discussed. compact two-column layout in figma, link in thread.

david: quick look 1 the compact version is tighter but worried the primary CTA is visually lost next to the sample tiles. can we give it stronger weight?

marco: what if primary CTA is full-width on mobile and elevated (shadow + primary token) on desktop? keeps hierarchy across breakpoints.

anya: yep that's the idea. on mobile primary becomes sticky at bottom with safe-area padding. added spec note.

maria: copy: instead of "Get started" let's use "Create sample project" to reduce ambiguity. also add short helper line: "Choose a sample to preconfigure your project and run the quickstart."

aria: accessibility: ensure the sticky CTA doesn't cover focusable content when it appears. it should appear after content via the DOM order or use aria-hidden toggles. also add skip link to jump past the tiles to the footer.

david: UI tweak: sample tiles should have focus-visible outline and a subtle hover elevation. avoid outline:none globally.

marco: analytics: we'll add a funnel event quickstart_empty_cta_click and quickstart_sample_launch. experimenting with CTA text A/B: create_vs_try. dataset owner please add flags.

maria: flag keys: onboarding_cta_text_v1/v2. metric names as marco suggested. i'll add to event spec doc.

designbot: reminder: include color token swap for dark mode. contrast for helper copy must be >= 3:1 or promote to 4.5:1 if it's primary info.

anya: implementation notes: i'll keep images 80px height, title + one-line summary, and actions hidden behind kebab for secondary options. will update figma and ping eng.

david: i'll pick this up next sprint. can we do paired QA with design for keyboard/voiceover? wed 11am PT works for me.

maria: i'll schedule and add checklist to PR template. please add final copy by EOD Friday so i18n can start.

anya: thanks all. final ask: add any microcopy tweaks in-thread so i can lock strings before handoff.
